question: Whose beloved image-sacrifice is to be done by the wise, and where do heroes and mutual powers abide?
premises: beloved image-sacrifice thus to be done by the wise
in red, in hidden, in house heroes; powers mutual too indeed
inference: Wise-made beloved image-rite houses heroes and mutual powers in red-hidden homes.
plain_english: Beloved image-sacrifice thus to be done by the wise — in red, in hidden, in house heroes; powers mutual too indeed.
